title: BOS-881 a gate that could not run reads as failed, beside a healthy gated job

scenes.title: the cron list shows a gated job and a gate_failed job side by side

steps.caption: Press [c] to open the Scheduled Jobs (cron) list
Cron list loaded; 'Backlog sweep' is the job whose gate could not run

expect.label: cron list column headers (CRON NAME REPO AGENT ENABLED LAST RUN NEXT RUN STATUS)
the healthy gated job is on screen
the gate_failed job is on screen
'Morning PR triage' (gate ran and said no) keeps the warning-styled 'gated' STATUS
'Backlog sweep' (gate could not run, outcome gate_failed) shows a red 'failed' STATUS — this is the whole ticket: the two are visually distinguishable

steps.caption: Both jobs are enabled and both had their fire blocked, but they no longer look alike: the gate that RAN and said no reads 'gated', while the gate that could not run at all (exit 127 — its interpreter is missing) reads 'failed'. Before BOS-881 both rendered 'gated' and a broken deployment looked like a quiet backlog.
